decisions.reason: The waste-oil-to-energy plant is a flagship in the firm's core waste-to-energy direction, but its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises some risk that it has been sidelined.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is still strategically aligned with the firm's mission, though it is technically and economically demanding and has had little visibility since 2019, which makes a withdrawal plausible.
